query:
SELECT 
  o.orderNumber,
  o.customerName,
  o.deliveryDate,
  op.productName,
  op.color,
  op.isGift
FROM orders o
JOIN orderProducts op ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE o.deliveryDate BETWEEN '2026-06-06' AND '2026-06-13'
  AND op.isGift = 'no'
ORDER BY o.deliveryDate, o.orderNumber;
